title: Lawn seating.
officialText:
Lawn seating areas and exterior overflow seating areas, where fixed seats are not provided, shall connect to
an accessible route.
1108.2.7Assistive listening systems. Each assembly area where audible communications are integral to the use of the space shall
have an assistive listening system in compliance with ICC A117.1, including Section 706 (Assistive Listening Systems) and
Appendix N of this code.
Exception: Other than in courtrooms, an assistive listening system is not required where there is no audio amplification system.
